flows.name: new-team-generation
flows.parallel: rule-writer, skill-writer and agent-writer write disjoint path families at the same time from frozen planning decisions. Each returns a short report and its context is discarded.
flows.isolated_check: decision-auditor accepts the frozen batch from fresh context, given only acceptance criteria and artifact paths.
flows.why: Three writers have no dependency on each other once planning is frozen, and acceptance must not inherit the writers' reasoning.

flows.name: text-only-optimization
flows.isolated_check: decision-auditor confirms the optimizer changed wording and not behaviour, without seeing the optimizer's reasoning.
flows.why: The edit itself is one context and one owner. The group exists only for the check against the author, so it is two roles, not the full roster.
